sentences.en: Owing to the rain, the athletic meeting was put off.
sentences.zh: 因为下雨，运动会推迟了。

sentences.en: This beautiful garden owes more to art than to nature.
sentences.zh: 这个美丽的花园更得益于艺术而非自然。

sentences.en: I'm sorry to have troubled you owing to our mistake.
sentences.zh: 抱歉因我们的错误给你添麻烦了。

senses.zh: 欠；感激；应给予；应该把……归功于
